name: color_naming
description: Name the typical colour of a common object, few-shot ('banana: yellow'). Control: same objects/format but answer is the object's first word copied in capitals? No - control answers the object's category noun (fruit/animal/etc).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
objs=[('banana','yellow','fruit'),('lemon','yellow','fruit'),('strawberry','red','fruit'),('cherry','red','fruit'),('tomato','red','vegetable'),('lime','green','fruit'),('cucumber','green','vegetable'),('broccoli','green','vegetable'),('carrot','orange','vegetable'),('pumpkin','orange','vegetable'),('eggplant','purple','vegetable'),('grape','purple','fruit'),('blueberry','blue','fruit'),('coconut','brown','fruit'),('potato','brown','vegetable'),('spinach','green','vegetable'),('crow','black','animal'),('swan','white','animal'),('flamingo','pink','animal'),('frog','green','animal'),('canary','yellow','animal'),('raven','black','animal'),('polar bear','white','animal'),('elephant','gray','animal'),('pig','pink','animal'),('cardinal','red','animal'),('snow','white','weather'),('grass','green','plant'),('sky','blue','nature'),('coal','black','mineral'),('chocolate','brown','food'),('milk','white','drink'),('blood','red','body fluid'),('ocean','blue','nature'),('fire truck','red','vehicle'),('school bus','yellow','vehicle'),('cloud','white','weather'),('mouse','gray','animal'),('lettuce','green','vegetable'),('ruby','red','gem'),('emerald','green','gem'),('sapphire','blue','gem')]
items=[];control=[]
for _ in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(objs,3)
    items.append({"prompt":"Name the colour.\n"+"".join(f"{o}: {c}\n" for o,c,_ in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2][0]}:","answer":" "+ex[2][1]})
    control.append({"prompt":"Name the category.\n"+"".join(f"{o}: {k}\n" for o,_,k in ex[:2])+f"{ex[2][0]}:","answer":" "+ex[2][2]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
